overall_status: MATCH: the four-case projection (reverse post order with per-block index, final rootlist, per-block immediate dominator) byte-matches the locked oracle on both entries — the structureLoops->findSpanningTree reorder chain consumed by Funcdata::structureReset, and the side-effect-free build_dom_tree entry (local-RPO path) used by heritage/blockaction/coreaction glue callers; findIrreducible/calcLoop (irreducible-CFG rebuild) and the removeUnreachableBlocks consumer of the blocks_unreachable flag are outside this fixture and registered separately
architecture: locked synthetic plain FlowBlock graphs built through production BlockGraph::newBlock/addEdge; no AddrSpace, no Funcdata, no PcodeOps (structureLoops and calcForwardDominator touch only blocks, edges, and FlowBlock scalar state)
compiler_spec: not applicable: no Funcdata, no prototype model, no symbols (pure BlockGraph fixture)

analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of locked BlockGraph::structureLoops + calcForwardDominator on synthetic component graphs built through production BlockGraph APIs; the Rust side additionally runs BlockGraph::build_dom_tree on fresh identical graphs and asserts the same immediate-dominator set (silent on success so stdout stays byte-identical)
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh BlockGraph with blocks appended in a fixed vector order and edges inserted in a fixed order (the in-edge order of merges feeds the calcForwardDominator first-processed-predecessor scan, block.cc:1995-1999)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: title; rpo line = component list order after `list = rpostorder` (block.cc:1135) with each block's index field; rootlist line = final rootlist after the block.cc:1129 swap; one idom line per block in list order with the immed_dom block name or NULL
analysis_options.normalization: Block identity prints as per-case names (E/A/B/O1/O2, R0/M/X/R1, X/Y), never pointers. NULL is printed for immed_dom == 0 (the virtual-root excise result and the single-root cc:2031 clear). No index normalization is needed: both sides print the same reverse-post-order numbers.

input_manifest.canonicalization: case titles plus block/edge lists as listed below
cases: case A multi-root trailing orphans: blocks E,A,B,O1,O2 (vector order), edges E->A, A->B; O1/O2 are in0/out0 orphans appended at the END of the component vector — the httpd lifter shape. Pins the rootlist head/tail swap (block.cc:1031-1035): E (the first sizeIn()==0 candidate) finishes the DFS last and takes RPO slot 0; orphans may never steal RPO[0]. rootlist ends [E, O1, O2]; E/O1/O2 all idom NULL (virtual-root create + excise); A idom E; B idom A.

case B single root with back-edge into entry: blocks E,A; edges E->A, A->E. Pins the createVirtualRoot branch at block.cc:1978-1984 (rootlist.size()==1, rootlist[0]==b, b->sizeIn()!=0): E gets an artificial root and ends with immed_dom NULL; A idom E.

case C cross-root merge: blocks R0,M,X,R1 (vector order), edges R0->M, R1->M, M->X (in-edge order of M = [R0, R1]). Pins the virtual-root finger-arithmetic alias: a freshly constructed FlowBlock has index == 0 (block.cc:61-69), so a finger walking into the virtual root lands on numnodes-0 = the postorder slot of list[0]; the merge M of two different roots' subtrees converges to immed_dom == R0 (NOT NULL). R0/R1 idom NULL; M idom R0; X idom M.

case D pure cycle, no root candidate: blocks X,Y; edges X->Y, Y->X. Pins the rootlist fallback rootlist = { list[0] } (block.cc:1036-1038): X assumed entry, X idom NULL (back-edge-into-entry virtual root), Y idom X.

observation_schema.format: Four case records, each: title line, rpo line, rootlist line, then one idom line per block in final list order, final newline
observation_schema.state: per-block index (reverse post order) on the rpo line; per-block immed_dom (name or NULL) on idom lines
observation_schema.graph: final component list order (list = rpostorder), final rootlist order after the block.cc:1129 swap
